title: Add an Export branch for uploading the report
body:
The skill now has a short Export section. The last workflow step is a branch: upload the report, and it exports a static site. Otherwise it serves the local UI. It does not do both.

When opening a PR, agents export that review and publish the folder with VibeDrop (`npx -y @vibedrop/cli deploy "$EXPORT_DIR"`), then put the site URL in the PR body. The VibeDrop skill lives in `.agents/skills/vibedrop`.

Checked against PR #49: https://5xdyym5j.vibedrop.site/

Posted by [Cursor] [cursor-grok-4.6]
